name: Trigger
source:
Wendy, a 30-something housewife, uncovers a mystery from her past that may undo her marriage—and her sanity. A digital choose-your-own adventure story with multiple endings that reveal different aspects of Wendy's past.

[From [url=https://patchydollgames.itch.io/trigger]itch.io[/url]]
